<title level="1" right="Fey Patronage " pfs="">[Oath of Delight](/FeyPatronages.aspx?ID=1)</title>

**Source** [Feybound](/Sources.aspx?ID=379) pg. 20

You’ve sworn an oath to bring joy to the world (all worlds, really) through your performances.

**Edicts** attempt to defuse hostile situations using art, showcase your performance skills at every opportunity

**Anathema** allow your artistic skills to go fallow through lack of practice, disparage an honest attempt at a performance by another, refuse to perform for a fey audience

---

**Boon** Your fey patron blesses your performances for others. When you succeed at a check to [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=2364) using Performance, you get a critical success instead.

**Curse** If you won't voluntarily entertain, then your fey patron curses you to do so involuntarily. Minor mishaps make many of your actions seem foolish or draw attention to you. Whenever you attempt a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38), [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40), or [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) check, you must roll twice and take the worse result. This is a [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=654) effect.

<title level="1" right="Fey Patronage " pfs="">[Oath of Fealty](/FeyPatronages.aspx?ID=2)</title>

**Source** [Feybound](/Sources.aspx?ID=379) pg. 20

You’ve sworn an oath to serve a specific fey for a set period—typically, to serve the fey to whom you swore the oath for a year and a day. Some powerful fey will manipulate time in their domain to extend the duration of this oath.

**Edicts** perform all duties requested of you by the fey to which you’re sworn for as long as promised

**Anathema** attack, betray, or harm the fey to which you’re sworn, allow that fey to come to harm through your inaction, refuse an order from that fey

---

**Boon** Your fey patron steps in to keep you, their servant, alive for another day. Once, your fey patron ends all negative effects affecting you, unless they're from an artifact, deity, or similarly powerful source; they also restore all lost Hit Points and replenish your spells, Focus Points, and other daily resources. Your fey patron will typically do this in only the direst of circumstances.

**Curse** Your fey patron turns the weight of your obligation to them from metaphorical to physical. You're permanently [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 1 and encumbered.
name: Oath of Fealty

<title level="1" right="Fey Patronage " pfs="">[Oath of Hospitality](/FeyPatronages.aspx?ID=3)</title>

**Source** [Feybound](/Sources.aspx?ID=379) pg. 20

You’ve sworn an oath to show hospitality to all, especially fey.

**Edicts** show good hospitality (which includes food and a place to rest should they be requested) to all guests in any property you view as your home

**Anathema** refuse entry to a traveler who hasn’t shown you hostility, refuse to grant shelter to a fey who hasn’t attacked you, throw a nonviolent guest out of your home

---

**Boon** Your fey patron grants you the ability to keep your tables full for company. Once per week, you can cast [create food](/Spells.aspx?ID=1475) as an innate primal spell, though you must do so to feed any guests you might have before you partake yourself.

**Curse** Your fey patron ensures that all fey know of your lack of courtesy. Fey creatures' attitudes toward you are one category worse (friendly instead of [helpful](/Conditions.aspx?ID=78), [indifferent](/Conditions.aspx?ID=82) instead of [friendly](/Conditions.aspx?ID=75), and so on).
name: Oath of Hospitality

anathema: attack a fey protecting a natural space, pollute a natural space, take more from nature than what you need to survive
edict: defend wilderness from development or destruction, prevent others from taking more than they need to survive
markdown:
<title level="1" right="Fey Patronage " pfs="">[Oath of the Wilds](/FeyPatronages.aspx?ID=4)</title>

**Source** [Feybound](/Sources.aspx?ID=379) pg. 20

You've sworn an oath to protect nature from encroaching civilization and from those who would despoil it or recklessly plunder its resources. Some fey will instead request an oath to protect a specific region, rather than nature as a whole.

**Edicts** defend wilderness from development or destruction, prevent others from taking more than they need to survive

**Anathema** attack a fey protecting a natural space, pollute a natural space, take more from nature than what you need to survive

---

**Boon** Your fey patron grants you the ability to move swiftly through natural spaces. You ignore [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) caused by plants and fungi, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth.

**Curse** Your fey patron turns nature against you. Whenever you take damage from a creature or hazard with the [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=531), [fungus](/Traits.aspx?ID=614), or [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=668) traits, you're [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 2.
name: Oath of the Wilds
